effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] By trashing the top card of your security stack, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, you may play 1 yellow Tamer card from your hand without paying its cost.
